paraphrase: Producer notes describe four methods: manual stopwatch, self-timing g-ball, light gates/data logger, and an electronic release/impact timer. The g-ball is released using a bracket on a metre rule; its clock starts on release and stops at impact, with 0.01 s display resolution. Multiple drop heights are discussed. Notes identify start/stop timing, air resistance and height measurement as distinct uncertainty sources. No camera model, actual filming cadence or per-segment speed/edit mapping was found in the reviewed notes. Apparatus timing is not automatically the camera clock. The ruler's projection into the ball trajectory plane remains unverified.
